عَيْجٌ an inf. n. of 1. (Lth, O, &c.) ―
-b2- Also Profit, advantage, or utility. (TA.) ―
-b3- And [its pl.] أَعْيَاجٌ signifies Any means of satisfying a man's thirst: [and ↓ عِيَاجٌ seems to have a similar signification, for it is immediately added,] and one says, اللَّبَنُ عِيَاجٌ [app. meaning Milk is a thing that satisfies thirst]. (O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
